source.title: Open problems related to quadrature domains

trace.notes: Normalized https://zbmath.org/2226537 as a zbMATH resolver record. Direct local fetch returned HTTP 403 with Cloudflare challenge headers, so the resolver page was classified as blocked_or_challenged.

Queried the official zbMATH API endpoint https://api.zbmath.org/v1/document/2226537. Metadata identified Zbl 1083.31007, title "Open problems related to quadrature domains", document type serial article, pages xi-xxviii in Quadrature Domains and Their Applications. The API links field was empty, so metadata was used only for identity recovery.

Tried exact-work recovery by title and identifiers. The Springer book page for DOI https://doi.org/10.1007/b137105 exposed only preview/book metadata; the Springer front-matter PDF candidate bfm:978-3-7643-7316-0/1.pdf was identified but could not be downloaded and text-extracted in this run; the HBZ PDF candidate failed DNS resolution; Scribd/zlibrary-like candidates were rejected as non-authoritative and/or polluted with advertising and unrelated text. No clean readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source was recovered within the bounded pass.
Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source.
Saved JSON to outputs/parse-paper/2226537.json and outputs/latest.json.
